newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha gains $1-2 with gasoline, crude gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha gains $1-2 with gasoline, crude gains.

text.p: NWE naphtha $1-2 a tonne firmer on Friday as stronger gasoline and crude lifted naphtha.
Dealers said a trader bid for a 70 paraffinic grade cargo for delivery before August 25 at $198 cif NWE, about $1.50 higher than Wednesday.
Yesterday saw an Alexandria cargo sold at around $196-197 cif NWE.
Trader interest continued to dominate the market with end-user remaining sidelined.
"At these sort of prices we are keeping quiet," said one.
Swaps for the balance of August were $1-2 a tonne firmer at $194.50 with the backwardation into September holding at $5.00.
Several September swaps traded up to and including $188.50, dealers said.
